run.head: unborn-railly/mvp
gaps: The target repository has no commit, so no exact HEAD can be reviewed or covered.
No different-family reviewer was available for this run.

The signed app built, installed, launched, and remained running on the paired physical iPhone, but authenticated Gateway use, App Attest verification, background reconnect, and real APNs delivery remain unverified.
The Mac app bundle is Developer ID signed but no Pocket Factory notarytool keychain profile is configured.

acceptance_reviewed: SwiftUI is a replaceable decision client and stores no provider secrets.
Gateway and workers own durable execution, evidence, and replay-safe state.
Human decisions bind exact SHA, evidence digest, gate version, session, nonce, and expiry.
A registered Mac connects outward and runs coding agents in an isolated local checkout.
No branch, remote push, or draft pull request exists before exact-SHA approval.
Feedback is reproduced and classified before one minimum successor is dispatched.
An APNs notification can open only its exact Case and carries no decision or execution authority.
gaps: No separate Spec review status was supplied; this report records Standards review only.

lenses.name: Inverse regression surface
lenses.reason: No matcher, parser, or lookup data source was replaced.

lenses.name: New-domain matrix
lenses.reason: Auth, worker enrollment, feedback URLs, and exact SHA inputs were checked at their widened boundaries.

lenses.name: Resolution-rule consistency across consumers
lenses.reason: No shared user-input resolver was deepened or replaced.

lenses.name: Shell re-parse append domain
lenses.reason: The implementation does not append user input to shell-parsed command strings.

lenses.name: Emission channel and one-shot latch reachability
lenses.reason: Worker outbox receipts, SSE cursors, and terminal attempt envelopes were traced through reconnect paths.

lenses.name: Shim hermeticity
lenses.reason: Mac execution no longer shares writable node_modules with the source checkout.

lenses.name: Deliberate-default check
lenses.reason: Demo mutation and non-loopback auth require explicit configuration; production defaults fail closed.

lenses.name: Fresh-seam scan
lenses.reason: No adjacent optional adapter was newly claimed complete without an implementation path.

lenses.name: Substrate differential corpus
lenses.reason: No platform parser or serializer differential was introduced.

lenses.name: Reference-implementation oracle
lenses.reason: No local reference implementation defines the Gateway protocol behavior.

lenses.name: New-failure-outcome propagation
lenses.reason: Sandbox, promotion, auth, feedback, and send-back failures were traced to durable attempt and ledger outcomes.

lenses.name: Flag-propagation dispatch sweep
lenses.reason: POCKET_DEMO_MODE and POCKET_OPERATOR_TOKEN were traced across exchange, capabilities, demo routes, and Swift settings.

lenses.name: Error-path forcing
lenses.reason: Stale cursors, replay, failed proof, revoked workers, wrong PR SHA, absent Connect, and invalid SHA were forced.

lenses.name: Non-destructive recovery
lenses.reason: Retry and send-back create immutable successor attempts while prior ledger events and refs remain intact.

lenses.name: Cancellation and timeout hygiene
lenses.reason: Promotion waits are bounded and cleaned up; active cancellation is proven and APNs retries remain durable until a terminal provider response.

lenses.name: Boundary pipeline trace
lenses.reason: SwiftUI to Gateway to Mac or Sandbox to proof to decision to promotion was traced end to end.

lenses.name: Substrate verification
lenses.reason: Real Sandbox and Mac changes, git result refs, worker receipts, simulator UI, and fail-closed promotion were observed.

lenses.name: Dogfood the built artifact
lenses.reason: The built simulator app drove approval, failed promotion, feedback classification, and a successor proof; the signed Mac app bundle installed a real LaunchAgent and reconnected the registered worker.

lenses.name: Docs-behavior parity
lenses.reason: README and shaping status were reconciled with the actual proven and pending paths.

lenses.name: Demonstrative example
lenses.reason: No documentation example is used as proof of a new capability.

lenses.name: Choice audit
lenses.reason: No .decisions.tsv trail exists.

lenses.name: Complexity budget
lenses.reason: Ledger and persistence serialization are linear per event and do not add nested per-item scans on hot paths.

deterministic.reason: Biome passed and 36 Bun tests passed on the final tree, including cancellation, APNs routing, source and packaged LaunchAgent lifecycle, dry-run, audit, and CLI output contracts.

A Developer ID signed PocketWorker.app passed deep strict codesign verification, emitted the real CLI schema, generated a valid ZIP with checksum sha256:54231777ee631f6cd03206d63b2f934dedb84406c16ce3ff7f6c86cbb4715172, produced a source-independent secret-free LaunchAgent, and reconnected the Petdex worker as online.
Forced ENOSPC removed the staging directory and archive and published no unsigned final output; a later archive-space failure left only a fully verified signed app.

The final SwiftUI tree built for arm64 iOS Simulator and a physical iPhone with whole-module compilation, development APNs entitlement, automatic provisioning under team 477PL8P3CL, and exact Case deep links.
PocketFactory.app installed on an iPhone 15 Plus, launched through devicectl, and remained visible as a running process.
All five current XCTest cases passed on iPhone 17 Pro Simulator, including exact Case deep-link parsing.
swiftc frontend parse passed for all app and test sources.
JSON schemas now include feedback events, behavior and detail fields, and full lowercase 40-character SHAs.
A non-loopback token exchange was forced to return 401 without the operator token and 200 with it.

An isolated Gateway drill returned 201 without the token, replayed one unresolved Ledger attention event, rejected cross-device deletion with 403, accepted own-device deletion with 204, and payload tests contain only exact Case navigation.
HEAD is unborn, so exact-SHA coverage is impossible and the run remains incomplete.

findings.claim: Concurrent JSON and ledger writes could race and lose or duplicate state; fixed with serialized atomic persistence.
findings.evidence: AtomicJSONWriter and concurrent ledger tests now preserve monotonic state.
findings.path: worker or API callback -> store mutation -> atomic temp file -> rename

findings.claim: The operator HTTP surface could inject worker envelopes without worker authority; fixed by removing the route and enforcing attempt ownership.
findings.evidence: Only authenticated worker sockets and registered DevBox provider callbacks can ingest envelopes.
findings.path: worker result -> authenticated provider channel -> attempt ownership -> ledger

findings.claim: LAN session exchange and demo mutation were open by default; fixed with an operator token and explicit demo mode.
findings.evidence: Forced auth returned 401 without the token and 200 with it; demo routes return 404 unless enabled.
findings.path: iPhone -> auth exchange -> session -> protected Gateway routes

findings.claim: Mac attempts shared writable dependencies with the source checkout; fixed with an isolated APFS clone and no node_modules symlink.
findings.evidence: Worker checkout preparation no longer creates a shared dependency link.
findings.path: Mac worker -> isolated checkout -> agent and checks

findings.claim: The GitHub token could appear in git process arguments; fixed with a temporary askpass helper and environment-only token delivery.
findings.evidence: Promotion command arguments no longer embed the token and the helper is removed in finally.
findings.path: Vercel Connect token -> Gateway -> Mac worker -> git credential prompt

findings.claim: Concurrent proof challenges and promotion retries could create conflicting decisions or duplicate PRs; fixed with exact-proof exclusion, active promotion guards, and existing-draft lookup.
findings.evidence: Decision conflict and GitHub retry tests pass, including reuse of an exact-SHA draft PR.
findings.path: proof challenge -> decision -> promotion lock -> existing PR lookup or draft creation

findings.claim: Send-back recorded a verdict but did not dispatch corrective work; fixed by creating an immutable successor attempt from the rejected exact SHA.
findings.evidence: The simulator feedback path produced successor WI-20260814-7a86c3 and exact result SHA 0c6cc047f03c408a0d0d89d2243e620038e8cf70.
findings.path: human send-back -> Gateway decision -> Mac attempt -> successor proof

findings.claim: Sandbox setup failure could leave AttemptStore running while the ledger said failed; fixed by recording the terminal attempt state in the outer failure path.
findings.evidence: The outer Sandbox catch now closes a still-running attempt before appending failure.
findings.path: Sandbox create or run failure -> AttemptStore failed -> ledger failed

findings.claim: Feedback accepted arbitrary URLs; fixed by requiring HTTPS GitHub URLs under the Work Item repository.
findings.evidence: Feedback ingestion now binds URL host and path to Formula repository ownership.
findings.path: review URL -> repository boundary -> feedback claim

findings.claim: Physical-device identity and local approval are production-grade.
findings.evidence: The app built with APNs entitlement, installed, launched, and remained running on the paired iPhone, but the authenticated decision path and App Attest server verification were not driven.
findings.path: iPhone Secure Enclave -> App Attest -> Gateway decision

findings.claim: Approved promotion creates exactly one draft PR through Vercel Connect.
findings.evidence: The missing connector failed closed and mocks prove exact-SHA behavior, but no real connector was configured.
findings.path: approved SHA -> Vercel Connect -> git push -> GitHub draft PR

findings.claim: Cancellation could be lost across worker reconnect or fail to stop the active agent; fixed with shared worker state, AbortSignal propagation into Kai, subprocess termination, and a typed terminal receipt.
findings.evidence: Real drill WI-20260814-bf8112 reached attempt-cancelled on the unchanged exact SHA, returned the worker online, drained outbox to zero, and removed its worktree.
findings.path: iPhone cancel -> Gateway ownership check -> Mac controller -> Kai subprocess -> cancelled envelope -> ledger

findings.claim: review-gate covered reports PASS on an unborn repository after fatal git errors.
findings.evidence: gate.sh covered exited 0 and printed PASS with an empty HEAD while git rev-parse HEAD exited 128.

findings.claim: Background attention could become a remote approval channel or duplicate alerts; fixed by limiting APNs payloads to exact Case navigation and persisting one delivery per event and device.
findings.evidence: Provider, router, deduplication, token-removal, session ownership, and payload-authority tests pass; the current SwiftUI tree builds with the notification path.
findings.path: ledger event -> durable notification router -> APNs -> exact Case deep link

findings.claim: The Mac worker depended on a foreground terminal and lacked a machine-readable service contract; fixed with a reversible audited LaunchAgent lifecycle and schema-first CLI.
findings.evidence: The real lifecycle drill reached online with PID 31536, then removed the service cleanly; tests prove dry-run, secret-free plist output, audit receipts, and enrollment-state preservation.
findings.path: pocket-worker CLI -> LaunchAgent -> outbound worker -> Gateway registry

findings.claim: A compiled worker LaunchAgent referenced /$bunfs/root/cli.ts and could not run outside the source build; fixed with a signed app bundle, native Swift launcher, bundled Bun runtime, and explicit packaged executable propagation.
findings.evidence: The packaged plist invoked PocketWorker.app/Contents/MacOS/pocket-worker, contained no source path or enrollment secret, and the Gateway observed the Petdex worker online.
findings.path: LaunchAgent -> signed Swift launcher -> bundled Bun -> sealed worker.js -> Gateway

findings.claim: A signing or archive failure could leave a partial package at the final output path; fixed with a staging directory and publication only after deep signature verification.
findings.evidence: Forced ENOSPC returned nonzero with no final output, staging directory, or archive; when ZIP creation later exhausted space, the only retained output was already Developer ID signed and passed deep strict verification.
findings.path: build staging -> sign -> verify -> publish -> archive -> optional notarize

findings.claim: The distributed Mac bundle passes Apple notarization and Gatekeeper on a fresh Mac.
findings.evidence: Developer ID signing and deep strict verification passed, but no Pocket Factory notarytool keychain profile exists, so submission, stapling, and fresh-machine Gatekeeper assessment were not driven.
findings.path: signed app -> notarytool -> stapled ZIP -> fresh Mac Gatekeeper

exemptions.claim: Direct Vercel DevBox execution is not implemented.
exemptions.evidence: The public owner boundary remains unclear; the WorkerProvider abstraction and proven Sandbox adapter preserve replacement without depending on an internal API.

exemptions.claim: The optional mobile terminal is not implemented.
exemptions.evidence: V8 is explicitly nice-to-have and terminal bytes have no authority over evidence, decisions, or promotion in the MVP core.

issue_candidates.title: Make review-gate head coverage fail closed on unborn repositories
issue_candidates.evidence: gate.sh covered prints PASS and exits 0 after git reports that HEAD is ambiguous and cannot resolve a revision.
issue_candidates.why_out_of_scope: The defect belongs to the canonical review-gate tooling repository, not the Pocket Factory implementation.
